messages:
Devin: FYI noticed a spike in pod churn in ap-southeast2 warm-pool since ~03:10 UTC. Tiny inference pods being evicted and rescheduled repeatedly. Dash shows retry loops + 502s.

Maria: saw alert, are kubelet OOMs or node reboots showing up?

Devin: checked node syslogs, seeing conntrack table warnings and short NIC stalls. pasted dump: https://internal.redwood/dumps/apse2-conntrack-03-10

Jonah: conntrack exhaustion will cause transient NetworkUnavailable -> kube-probe failures -> eviction wave. Any pattern on which nodes?

Sam: narrowed it down: warm-pool autoscaling groups only. Regular nodes are fine. Warm-pool eviction rate 10x higher.

Jonah: warm pools use aggressive lease-timeout=15s and early-preempt. If probe misses from transient egress stall, scheduler may evict quickly.

Liz: can we bump probe/lease thresholds as a temporary mitigation? Also consider nf_conntrack_max increase on AMI.

Devin: spun a canary: set lease-timeout=45s and disabled aggressive-preempt for 1 warm-pool ASG (az-a). Will observe for 15m.

ops-bot: Deploy request accepted - warm-pool az-a: lease-timeout=45s; aggressive-preempt=false; batch=1

Maria: ops SRE: please check nf_conntrack_max on AMI. Suggested quick sysctl: net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144 on hot AMIs.

Jonah: increasing conntrack headroom helps but root cause is bursty egress from one tenant. Could also throttle client token bursts on inference SDK. Suggest adding a 50ms inter-token pacing flag for affected tenant.

Sam: canary update after 12m: eviction-rate dropped from 0.9/min -> 0.04/min on the patched warm-pool. Conntrack still spikes but no more immediate evictions.

Liz: action items:
- Maria: open AMI PR with sysctl bump and bake image (netfilter nf_conntrack_max=262144)
- Jonah: change platform default warm-pool lease-timeout 15s -> 30s and make aggressive-preempt opt-in
- Devin: add client-side pacing toggle and roll to top offender tenant
- Sam: monitor the AZ for 6 hours; escalate if spillover

Devin: quick log snippet for context: 
```
Apr 20 03:11:02 node-apse2 kubelet[1234]: NodeNotReady: NetworkUnavailable
Apr 20 03:11:08 kernel: nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet
Apr 20 03:11:15 kube-scheduler: Evicting pod inference-job-abc due to NodeNotReady
```

Maria: I'll run a small staging perf test with higher conntrack limits before AMI bake.

Jonah: pinging eng-infra for review on making sysctl change default; want to know any side-effects to non-inference workloads.

Devin: I'll draft a brief runbook note and attach to the incident tracker. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
